name: payments-service-down
description: The payments service is down. It was healthy earlier today, but now it won't start — customers can't check out. Get it back online.
bugs: config/.env is missing the required STRIPE_API_KEY, so Settings() raises KeyError on boot
config/.env sets MAX_RETRIES=three, a non-integer that crashes int() parsing once the key issue is past

call_with_retries in app/payments.py loops `range(1, attempts)` — an off-by-one that runs one fewer than the configured number of attempts, so a transient provider failure that would clear within the retry budget is given up on prematurely; the happy-path self-check succeeds on the first try so this stays invisible at boot
correct_diagnosis: The service failed to boot because config/.env was missing the required STRIPE_API_KEY and set MAX_RETRIES to a non-integer ('three'). Underneath that, call_with_retries in app/payments.py looped over `range(1, attempts)`, an off-by-one that performs one fewer attempt than configured, so a provider failure that would clear within the retry budget is abandoned early; fixing the .env and changing the loop to `range(1, attempts + 1)` resolves both.

reference_fix.description: Repair config/.env (valid STRIPE_API_KEY + integer MAX_RETRIES) and fix the off-by-one in call_with_retries so it uses the full attempt budget.
reference_fix.cmd:
cat > config/.env <<'EOF'
# Payments service configuration
PORT=8080
MAX_RETRIES=3
STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_51FireDrillExampleKeyDoNotUse
ENV=production
EOF
python3 -c "import pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('app/payments.py'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('for attempt in range(1, attempts):', 'for attempt in range(1, attempts + 1):'); p.write_text(s)"

naive_fix.description: Trap bait: repair only config/.env so the service boots and the happy-path self-check passes — but leave the off-by-one in call_with_retries, so a transient provider failure within the retry budget is still abandoned early.
naive_fix.cmd:
cat > config/.env <<'EOF'
# Payments service configuration
PORT=8080
MAX_RETRIES=3
STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_51FireDrillExampleKeyDoNotUse
ENV=production
EOF
